data_fields.name: rateTable
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 category-pair rows x 9 tiers (common-to-common and rare-to-rare share one row)

data_fields.name: quantityBound
data_fields.donor_constant: source funds; buyable = funds x rate (to gold) or funds / rate (integer division)

best_idea: A barter rate read from a per-pair table, indexed by the owner's count of a building (nine tiers, clamped), with the quantity bounded by source funds and both sides committed together.
decision_why: The tiered category-pair table is data-driven and shared by player and AI, which fits one engine; the donor's local unchecked commit (subtract, then clamp to zero) must not be copied, so the server quotes and settles and refuses a short trade.
acceptance: Server test: with 3 marketplaces, selling 10 ore for gold credits exactly 500 gold and debits 10 ore; a trade of 5 wood with 4 held is refused with no change to either side; the trade window rate text equals the server quote; with 0 marketplaces no trade is offered.
